events.title: 1000 Mile BikeWalk for Prevention
events.description: The 1000 Mile BikeWalk for Prevention to be held October 31, 2026, Halloween morning. THIS IS A NEW DATE. The " Spooktacular " 1000 Miler is a regional fun ride/walk/run for kids, teens, adults... the whole family... to enjoy a fun and healthy morning while helping a good cause. Not a timed race, the 1000 Miler will record the distances traveled by every runner and rider to reach the cumulative event goal of 1000 miles. It's Halloween! Costumes and bike decorations are highly encouraged. Teams, too. Long and short biking and walking circuits of 15 and 5 miles and 1 mile, respectively, over semi-closed roadways, plus a 1/2 mile sidewalk-only Jr. BikeWaker route for kids. grandparents, etc..
